title: Tournament-GRPO：二值格式奖励 + 淘汰赛奖励账（栈式轨迹解析 + 结构校验 + M=4 重复 G=2 淘汰赛 + min-max 归一）
title_en: Tournament-GRPO: Binary Format Reward + Knockout Tournament Ledger (Stack-Based Transcript Parsing + Structure Validation + M=4 Repeats of G=2 Knockouts + Min-Max Normalization)
source_lines: reward.py 全文件（TAG_ERRORS / parse_attrs / parse_transcript / extract_answer / is_tool_cycle / check_structure / analyze_format / normalize_scores / run_tournament / score_group）
description: Tournament-GRPO 的核心主张：LLM-as-judge 直接给全组打分不稳定——让同题候选**两两淘汰赛**（judge 每场只看两个答案选一个胜者），胜场数作奖励更稳。官方 reward.py 的确定性账（LLM judge 入参化为 (seed, pick) 策略、random.Random(seed) 决定抽签），六入口复刻：parse——栈式轨迹解析：顶层标签块配对切出，错误按作者固定序收集（unknown_tags/invalid_attrs/broken_xml/stray_text_outside_tags），关闭标签与栈顶不匹配时**回退到栈里最近同名开标签、中间未闭合标签静默丢弃**，只有 call_tool 允许属性且必须 name、属性间杂文或重复 key 即 invalid，标签外杂文记 stray；answer——<answer> 必须唯一、非空、不含标签、位于轨迹末尾；format——0/1 二值：TAG_ERRORS 固定序 + tool:unknown_tool_name + answer:invalid_or_missing，全过才做结构校验（think 开头非空 → 每段 ≥1 轮 google_search 循环 + 任意轮 browse_webpage 循环，每轮 call_tool→tool_output→think 三块非空 → answer）；normalize——组内 min-max、全同分全 0.5；tournament——M=4 次重复每次重新 shuffle 抽签、G=2 人/场（**轮转分组 candidates[i::num_groups]，奇数候选出 3 人组**）、每场 judge 选一胜者 +1 分、K=8 时 4+2+1=7 场/次共 28 场；score——总分 = min-max 归一锦标赛分 + 0/1 格式分（0–2），无答案候选以空串参赛但**归一化后锦标赛分置 0**，judge 只看提取答案（截 120000 字符）、query strip。
description_en: Tournament-GRPO's core claim: LLM-as-judge scoring a whole group at once is unstable — have same-question candidates play a **two-player knockout** (the judge sees only the two answers per match and picks one winner), and use win counts as rewards. This problem replicates the deterministic accounting of the official reward.py (the LLM judge parameterized as a (seed, pick) strategy, random.Random(seed) driving the draws) via six solve entries: parse — stack-based transcript parsing: top-level tag blocks are paired and sliced, errors collected in the author's fixed order (unknown_tags/invalid_attrs/broken_xml/stray_text_outside_tags), a close tag mismatching the stack top **falls back to the nearest same-name opener and silently drops the in-between unclosed tags**, only call_tool may carry attributes and must carry name, stray text between attributes or duplicate keys are invalid, stray text outside tags is recorded; answer — <answer> must be unique, non-empty, tag-free and trail the transcript; format — binary 0/1: TAG_ERRORS in fixed order + tool:unknown_tool_name + answer:invalid_or_missing, with structure checked only when everything else passes (non-empty think first → each segment has >=1 google_search cycle plus any number of browse_webpage cycles, each cycle being non-empty call_tool→tool_output→think → answer); normalize — group min-max, all-equal → 0.5 each; tournament — M=4 repeats with fresh shuffles, G=2 players per match (**round-robin grouping candidates[i::num_groups], a 3-player group appears on odd candidate counts**), the judge picks one winner per match at +1, 4+2+1=7 matches per repeat for K=8, 28 total; score — total = min-max normalized tournament reward + binary format reward (0–2), no-answer candidates enter with "" but get their **tournament reward zeroed after normalization**, the judge sees only extracted answers (truncated at 120000 chars) and the query is stripped.
notes: 官方账的关键细节（沙箱实测钉死）：(1) **栈式解析的回退语义**：关闭标签与栈顶不匹配时，找栈里**最近同名开标签**（没有则整个闭标签忽略 continue），它之上的未闭合标签全部静默丢弃（stack = stack[:index]）——嵌套 <div> 这类未知标签留在 content 里且记 unknown_tags。(2) 错误是**集合**去重后按 TAG_ERRORS 固定顺序输出（tool/answer/structure 追加在后）——同错多处女理一次。(3) 属性账三关：属性间杂文（text[cursor:match.start()].strip()）、重复 key、**call_tool 必须带 name 且只允许 name**（其他标签带任何属性即 invalid）——answer k="v" 也 invalid。(4) extract_answer 的四重门：恰好 1 个 <answer>、非空、内容无标签、**answer 闭标签后到文本尾无杂文**——尾随文字直接判废。(5) 结构校验只在标签零错且 answer 合法时跑（否则 failure 已非空）——作者的 must_end_with_answer / invalid_tool_cycle_order 两条检查因此恒不触发，官方代码省略了它们；结构账：think 开头非空、**每段必须以 google_search 循环开头**（browse 循环只能跟在 search 循环后同段内）、段数 ≥1（len(blocks) > 2）。(6) 淘汰赛抽签：rng 在**4 次重复间共享**（Random(seed) 一次创建、shuffle 顺序延续）——不是每次重复重置；轮转分组 candidates[i::num_groups] 把 shuffle 后的序列按 i%组数 分组，奇数候选（如 3、5 人）出 3 人组且**judge 一次看 3 个答案**。(7) 胜者 +1 后晋级，candidates 收缩到 1 结束本轮；K=8 每次重复 4+2+1=7 场、4 次 28 场。(8) normalize 是**先归一后置零**：无答案候选以空串参赛（judge 会看到空答案），归一化后 tournament_reward 才置 0——它的参赛仍影响**别人的 min-max 归一**（分母含它的 raw score）。(9) 总分 = tournament_reward + format_reward ∈ [0, 2]；format 全好的 good 轨迹即使锦标赛全败也拿 1 分。(10) 与 to-grpo-advantage 划界：GRPO 的组内标准化发生在 advantage 侧，本题是 reward 侧的赛程账（judge 对阵、胜场计数、归一）；verl 侧把 score 直接当 outcome reward。
notes_en: Key official details (pinned by sandbox runs): (1) **Fallback semantics of the stack parse**: when a close tag mismatches the stack top, find the **nearest same-name opener in the stack** (ignore the close tag entirely if none), silently dropping everything above it (stack = stack[:index]); nested unknown tags like <div> stay in the content and record unknown_tags. (2) Errors are a **set** deduplicated, then emitted in the fixed TAG_ERRORS order (tool/answer/structure appended after) — the same error at many sites records once. (3) The attribute ledger has three gates: stray text between attributes (text[cursor:match.start()].strip()), duplicate keys, and **call_tool must carry name and only name** (any attribute on other tags is invalid) — answer k="v" is invalid too. (4) extract_answer's four gates: exactly one <answer>, non-empty, tag-free content, and **no text after the closing answer tag** — trailing text invalidates it. (5) Structure validation runs only when tags are clean and the answer is valid (otherwise failures are already non-empty) — the author's must_end_with_answer / invalid_tool_cycle_order checks can never trigger there, so the official code omits them; the structure ledger: non-empty think first, **each segment must start with a google_search cycle** (browse cycles may only follow search cycles within a segment), at least one segment (len(blocks) > 2). (6) Tournament draws: the rng is **shared across the 4 repeats** (Random(seed) created once, shuffles continue) — not reset per repeat; round-robin grouping candidates[i::num_groups] splits the shuffled list by i%num_groups, odd candidate counts (3, 5) produce a 3-player group where the **judge sees 3 answers at once**. (7) Winners advance with +1 until candidates shrink to 1; K=8 plays 4+2+1=7 matches per repeat, 28 total. (8) normalize happens **before zeroing**: no-answer candidates enter with "" (the judge sees empty answers) and their tournament_reward is zeroed only after normalization — their participation still affects **everyone else's min-max normalization** (their raw score sits in the range). (9) Total = tournament_reward + format_reward ∈ [0, 2]; a fully format-clean transcript earns 1 even when it loses every match. (10) Boundary vs to-grpo-advantage: GRPO's group standardization lives on the advantage side; this problem is the reward-side bracket ledger (judge pairings, win counting, normalization) — the verl side feeds score straight in as the outcome reward.
